title.en: MALACAÑANG MODIFYING THE RATES OF IMPORT DUTY ON CERTAIN ARTICLES UNDER SECTION 104 OF THE TARIFF AND CUSTOMS CODE OF 1978

text.en:
The articles specifically listed in Annex "A" hereof, as classified
under Section 104 of the Tariff and Customs Code of 1978, as amended, shall be
subject to the Most-Favoured-Nation (MN) import duty indicated opposite each article.

The nomenclature and the rates of import duty on tariff headings
not enumerated and those listed but represented by the symbol " xx" shall remain in
force and in effect.

Upon the effectivity of this Executive Order, all articles listed in
Annex "A" which are entered or withdrawn from warehouses in the Philippines for
consumption shall be levied the MN rates of duty therein prescribed.
• .

This Executive Order shall be subject to the Implementing Rules
and Regulations guided by the provisions oh the Minimum Access Volume (MAV) set
by the Department of Agriculture.

All Presidential issuances, administrative rules and regulations, or
parts thereof, which are contrary to or inconsistent with this Executive Order are hereby
revoked or modified accordingly.
PGMA Hologram # 25562

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately following its
complete publication in two (2) newspapers of general circulation in the Philippines.
Done in the City of Manila, this 26th day of March
Two Thousand and Four.
in the year of Our Lord,
By the President:
ALBERTO G. ROMULO
Executive Secretary
PGMA Hologram # 25563
